description: Indicator reputation verdicts, CVE lookups (CVSS, EPSS, KEV) and prompt-injection scans for agents
name: com.ismalicious/mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: API key from https://ismalicious.com/app/account. Optional: without it the server starts in bootstrap mode and offers bootstrap_key.
environmentVariables.name: ISMALICIOUS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: API secret paired with the key
environmentVariables.name: ISMALICIOUS_API_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Replaces every tool's timeout, in milliseconds (defaults: gate 15000, check_indicator 25000, CVE 10000)
environmentVariables.name: ISMALICIOUS_TIMEOUT_MS

title: isMalicious threat intelligence for AI agents
